communityIntro.title: From the kind community
communityIntro.sub: Derived from 78 active participants in the morning rules exploration.

communityInsights.title: Early sunlight is the strongest single rule
communityInsights.body: Explorers logging 10+ min outdoor light before 9am report +1.2 points higher afternoon energy by week 4.

communityInsights.title: Stacking rules beats any single habit
communityInsights.body: Those logging 3+ morning rules see afternoon energy 1.6 points higher than baseline by week 3.

communityInsights.title: Weeks 3–5 are the critical window
communityInsights.body: Afternoon crash frequency drops most sharply in weeks 3–5 when explorers stay consistent with their rule stack.
